profile.summary: Seasoned Licensed Clinical Social Worker with 30+ years of progressive experience in behavioral health, psychiatric crisis intervention, and clinical leadership. Currently supervises a 24/7 psychiatric emergency response center and crisis call line, managing staff performance, clinical protocols, and quality assurance. Demonstrates deep expertise in biopsychosocial assessment, crisis intervention, psychotherapy across the lifespan, and program development. Skilled in clinical supervision, training curriculum design, electronic health record systems, and process improvement; has established and operated a private practice and served as faculty educator in medical residency programs. Operates with multicultural competence and strength-based management philosophy, with demonstrated impact on documentation quality, staff efficiency, and continuity of care.
